app.title: Ankle Fracture Classification
app.description: Answer the questions to obtain the Lauge-Hansen, Danis-Weber, AO/OTA, and Bartonicek classification

form.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one fractured malleolus

alerts.unimaleolarMedial: Unimalleolar medial malleolus fracture → **AO-44-A1, Lauge-Hansen PER/PA**
alerts.bimaleolarMedialPosterior: Bimalleolar medial + posterior fracture → **AO-44-A2, Lauge-Hansen PA**
alerts.infrasyndesmal: Infrasyndesmal fracture → **Weber A, AO-44-A1, Lauge-Hansen SA**
alerts.transsyndesmal: Transsyndesmal fracture → **Weber B, AO-44-B1, Lauge-Hansen SER**

results.title: Classification Results
results.noClassification: Could not determine classification with the provided data.
